value.rationale: The result identifies every shortest absent scattered subsequence, not just an algorithm or count, for an infinite natural paperfolding family, with exactly two independent free positions per 12-symbol absent block. The stronger theorem exposes a four-parameter block invariance for arbitrary concatenations, despite changes in their source strings. The explicit word-level language provides compressed description of 2^(2^(k-4)+1) absent words, gives a closed universality profile, and supplies a reusable symbolic finite-transfer phenomenon for subword-avoidance investigations. The natural paperfolding object and whole-length spectrum are motivated by classical word-combinatorics questions; the result is not a single unmotivated finite table.
